Figure 2: Illustration of the ProSPy framework. ProSPy consists of four stages: (A) data profiling, (B) progressive schema pruning, (C) agentic data fetching, and (D) Python analysis. It extracts structured data evidence from raw tables, prunes large schemas into task-relevant contexts, fetches intermediate views through a dialect-agnostic DSL-to-SQL interface, and performs final analysis with Python interpreter to produce the result CSV.
